passages.title: A Weekend in Erbil
passages.text: Last month, my cousins and I went to Erbil for a long weekend. We travelled by bus, and the journey took about five hours. On the first day, we visited the citadel in the centre of the city. It was very old and the view from the top was amazing. In the evening, we walked around the market and bought some presents for our parents. On the second day, it rained all morning, so we stayed in the hotel and played cards. In the afternoon, the weather got better and we had a picnic in a big park. It was a short trip, but we really enjoyed it, and we want to go back next spring.

passages.title: Learning to Cook
passages.text: Until last year, Karim couldn't cook at all. When he started university in Baghdad, he lived alone for the first time, and he ate fast food almost every day. After a few months, he felt tired and he spent too much money. So he decided to learn. He called his grandmother every weekend, and she explained her recipes step by step. At first, his rice was always too hard and his soup was too salty. But he didn't give up. Now he can cook five dishes, and on Thursdays he invites his friends for dinner. He says cooking is cheaper, healthier and more fun than he expected.
